artifact_observations.reasoning: The text intended to be on the label is nonsensical. Characters are malformed, merged, or invented. This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the texture of text without understanding orthography.

The texture of the 'tape' inside the spools lacks the fine, parallel striations expected of wound magnetic tape. It appears more like a smudged or noisy gradient, suggesting a lack of fine-grained physical simulation.

The edge of the cassette near the bottom right appears slightly warped and ill-defined, blending into the background shadow more than a rigid plastic object should. The geometry feels slightly soft rather than crisp.
